name: Kore tte, Riajuu? ~Kuro Gyaru ga, Doutei o Kyouiku Suru Sou Desu yo~
original_name: これって、リア充？ ～黒ギャルが、ドーテーを教育するそうですよ～
source:
"Hey, what the hell are you staring at? Who the hell are you again? Uh…"
"Don’t know this guy! Hey, you! What are you gawking at? Get outta here!"

That’s how things went for a while, until one afternoon after school.

Realizing there was no point in resisting or arguing, I just…
